components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA in Evergreen with accent glow; arrow nudges on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #1f5f47; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px -6px rgba(30,60,139,0.28); transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1a4c3a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px rgba(30,60,139,0.6); } .ds-btn-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline pill; border and text turn Evergreen on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #0f172a; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(100,116,139,0.15); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #1f5f47; color: #1f5f47; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px rgba(30,60,139,0.6); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Hairline-bordered soft rectangle with corner registration brackets; lifts with a tinted glow on hover.
components.html:
Hi Speed Extrusion

Multi-layered films of the highest quality, durability and strength.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(255,255,255,0.4), rgba(255,255,255,0.15), transparent); border: 1px solid rgba(100,116,139,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; transition: all 0.3s; max-width: 320px; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(30,60,139,0.3); box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -14px rgba(30,60,139,0.35); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #0f172a; font-size: 1.125rem; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #475569; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; } .ds-card-corner { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-color: rgba(30,60,139,0.4); border-style: solid; border-width: 0; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-card-corner.ds-tl { left: 8px; top: 8px; border-left-width: 1px; border-top-width: 1px; } .ds-card-corner.ds-tr { right: 8px; top: 8px; border-right-width: 1px; border-top-width: 1px; } .ds-card-corner.ds-bl { left: 8px; bottom: 8px; border-left-width: 1px; border-bottom-width: 1px; } .ds-card-corner.ds-br { right: 8px; bottom: 8px; border-right-width: 1px; border-bottom-width: 1px; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Boxless underline field; hairline turns Evergreen on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(100,116,139,0.15); padding: 12px 0; transition: border-color 0.2s; max-width: 320px; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: #1f5f47; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; border: none; background: transparent; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #0f172a; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; }

narrative.overview: The site treats the screen like the company's own product: a run of pristine white packaging film, printed in a single royal-blue ink with the logo's CMYK swoosh appearing only as trace registration hints. Everything sits on white or a barely-blue section tint; color is ink, not paint. Metallic and film qualities (foil-shine sweeps, Ken Burns drift, film-flow textures, a 5% grain overlay) supply the material feel of flexible packaging without ever darkening the substrate. Components are refined and restrained: type and real photography carry the page, chrome recedes. Layouts are dense and premium; the client explicitly dislikes blank space.
keyCharacteristics: Locked light/white theme — :root and .dark are identical by design; no dark mode without client approval
One interactive ink (evergreen); copper and CMYK accents are identity marks, not UI colors
Fluid everything: no container max-width, viewport-clamped edge padding, root font-size clamp above 1440px
Motion is ambient and compositor-friendly: transform-only loops, shared easing tokens, prefers-reduced-motion support

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Evergreen is the only color that means "interactive." If an element is blue, it must do something; if it does something, it is blue. CMYK accents never take on interactive meaning.

rules.name: The White Substrate Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are Film White or Section Tint only. No dark sections, no flooded brand-color panels. Style with the semantic tokens, never the raw primary/navy scales.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans and DM Sans are the only typefaces. No third font, no font swap, without client confirmation.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry the ink (blue/gold tint), never neutral black at high alpha.

dos: Do style with semantic tokens (bg-bg, bg-section, bg-card, text-fg, text-muted, border-line, bg-accent) so values stay swappable.
Do keep all imagery WebP, named <slug>-NN.webp, and route video embeds through components/ui/lite-video.tsx.
Do import easing/duration from components/motion/tokens.ts and reuse components/motion/* primitives for reveals.
Do keep layouts dense — the client reads whitespace as emptiness, not luxury.
Do keep ambient animation transform-only so it stays on the GPU compositor.
donts: Don't reintroduce a dark theme, theme toggle, or dark sections — the light lock is a client decision.
Don't use the raw primary/navy/gold Tailwind scales for new UI; they exist for legacy contrast math only.
Don't give Copper or the CMYK accents interactive meaning (One Ink Rule).
Don't add opaque 1px gray borders or neutral black drop shadows; hairlines are alpha'd, shadows are tinted.
Don't add a third typeface or swap Plus Jakarta Sans/DM Sans without client confirmation.
Don't drop a JPG/PNG into public/images/ — it undoes the ~300MB→17MB optimization win.
